h1: Custom Gray Lanyards for Your Organization
metaDescription: Order custom gray lanyards for your team or event. Durable, comfortable, and printable with your logo. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Gray lanyards offer a neutral, professional look that complements any logo or ID badge without clashing with corporate colors. They are a popular choice for offices, trade shows, and conferences because they blend seamlessly with uniforms or business attire. Whether you need breakaway safety lanyards for a manufacturing facility or simple badge holders for a company retreat, gray provides a versatile base for screen-printed or woven logos. Choose from polyester, nylon, or recycled materials to match your sustainability goals.
heroAltText: Stack of custom gray lanyards with metal clips and printed logos on a white background
